# Retainr

> Retainr is an all-in-one client management platform that helps freelancers and agencies scale their businesses through automation, productized services, and integrated billing.

Retainr provides comprehensive solutions for managing clients, projects, payments, and team collaboration. The platform supports white-label customization, recurring revenue models, and integrations with popular tools like Stripe, PayPal, and Zapier to streamline agency and freelance operations.

## Key Topics

- Client Management
- Agency Software
- Freelancer Tools
- White-Label Solutions
- Productized Services
- Payment Processing
- Project Management
- Client Portal
- Business Automation
- Recurring Revenue
- Team Collaboration
- Service Productization
- Zapier Integration
- Stripe & PayPal
- API & Webhooks
